<function name="ApplyShake" parent="cam" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Shakes the screen at a certain position.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="pos" type="Vector">Origin of the shake.</arg>
		<arg name="angles" type="Angle">Angles of the shake.</arg>
		<arg name="factor" type="number">The shake factor.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
